sentences.text: A review of colorectal cancer describes mechanisms by which Peptostreptococcus may act, promoting tumour cell proliferation, inducing epithelial-mesenchymal transition and reshaping the tumour microenvironment.
Peptostreptococcus anaerobius has been reported as selectively enriched in faecal and mucosal microbiota from patients with colorectal cancer, adhering to the cancer mucosa.
A study reported that giving Peptostreptococcus anaerobius abolished anti-PD1 therapy efficacy in mouse colorectal cancer models and induced intratumoral myeloid-derived suppressor cells.
A study reported Peptostreptococcus stomatis as enriched in colorectal cancer and as accelerating colonic tumorigenesis in models, suppressing apoptosis and impairing gut barrier function.
